purpose: Three overhead player design options for user selection; not integrated into the game.

options.name: Survivor
options.description: Olive field jacket, charcoal knit beanie, faded denim and brown boots.
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: main-player character sprite design option for an overhead 2D zombie survival game, a four-pose comparison sheet.
Reference image 1 is the game's existing player loadout sheet: use its EXACT straight overhead camera and right-facing orientation. Reference image 2 is the newly approved zombie pixel-art sprite sheet: match its chunky crisp pixel clusters, dark outlines, material detail and muted color shading. Human player must be visually distinct from zombies: healthy natural skin, purposeful posture, intact clothing, no green skin or glowing eyes.
CAMERA: orthographic straight DOWN at 90 degrees. Tops of head, shoulders, arms and boots seen from above. Head on right side of torso, back on left, shoulders run vertically on image, hands/weapon point right. Compact overhead silhouette. NO front-facing portrait, side elevation, three-quarter/isometric viewpoint or tall upright body.
LAYOUT: square canvas with EXACT 2 by 2 equal square cells. One complete overhead character in each cell with generous transparent padding. Same character, proportions, clothes and camera across all four poses; identical body scale and torso center. Character silhouette fits in about 60% of cell width, rifles and bat within 80%. Upper left: two-handed pistol ready, muzzle points right. Upper right: rifle ready with rear hand on grip and front hand on fore-end, muzzle points right. Lower left: baseball bat held in a believable two-hand ready pose, weapon extends upper-right. Lower right: unarmed guard, hands forward, one foot slightly stepping. Weapons appropriately proportioned, hands actually holding grips, no floating weapons.
STYLE: polished crisp detailed pixel art suited to the approved zombies. Restrained palette, warm natural hands, dark brown/charcoal boots, readable outlines, overhead upper-left light. No smooth vector geometry, no photorealism, no painterly blur. Entire background fully transparent alpha ZERO; NO backdrop, floor, ground plane, soft cast shadows, grey haze, checkerboard, labels, text, numbers, borders or decorative UI. Only four isolated sprites.
DESIGN OPTION: SURVIVOR: rugged everyday male survivor, warm tan skin on hands, charcoal grey knit beanie, worn olive green field jacket with visible seam and pocket pixel details, faded blue denim trousers, brown leather boots. Practical medium build and relaxed but alert posture. Preserve the familiar olive-jacket/beanie identity of the existing player, improving the artwork to match the new pixel zombies. No armor vest or backpack.
